findings.title: Cancelled response no longer sent
findings.evidence: The Cancel button (answerPermission with Cancelled) was replaced by Interrupt calling stop(); the PermissionResponse Cancelled path is now unreachable from the UI and the pending request's resolution depends on stop() handling it. Hardcoded title 'Permission request' and status 'asks' are placeholders.
findings.fix: Confirm stop() resolves the pending permission, or emit a Cancelled answer from Session.

findings.title: Permission options collapsed by kind
findings.evidence: option()/choose() use find() per kind (AllowOnce, AllowAlways, Reject*), so only one button per kind is shown. The replaced app.html rendered every request.options entry; a request with several options of one kind, or a kind not listed, loses choices and may leave only Interrupt.
findings.fix: Render one button per request.options entry (label from option), keeping kind only for styling.

findings.title: Formatting typo
findings.evidence: `protected readonly contextPercent =computed(() => {` lost the space after '=' in an unrelated line.

findings.title: Listbox contains non-option children
findings.evidence: div role=listbox holds as-list-group-label and a .history__open div alongside role=option rows; invalid ARIA ownership. Rows are also not keyed on group labels uniquely if labels repeat (track g.label).
findings.fix: Use role=group per section or drop listbox role; track groups by a unique id.

findings.title: Query input not reflected after clear
findings.evidence: Native input uses [value]=query() with (input) emitting; clearSearch only emits, so the field clears only if the parent resets query. Acceptable but undocumented; native input chosen over ui-text-input/autocomplete (reuse note).
findings.fix: Document the controlled contract or reuse the text-input component.
